  *How it works:* Divide the class into groups, assigning each group a different aspect of a topic or case. After discussing in their “expert” groups, students re-form into new groups with one member from each original group to teach each other.  
  *Logistics:* Works well if you have 30–45 minutes and a class size that divides easily into groups of 4–5. Requires some prep to create materials for each group.

- While groups are working, circulate around the room. Listen in, answer questions, and gently redirect if a group is off track.
